jobs.title: Senior System/Data Analyst, Global Tax Data
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon's Global Tax Data team seeks a capable and motivated individual to optimize tax data delivery processes by developing simple standard data models to drive evolution in our data management products. Success in our initiatives will ultimately lower the operation cost to serve Tax Compliance and Controllership.

The right individual should have an ability to work with large datasets. They will also have solid business judgment that enables their development of business logic to transform data and meet the needs of Tax and Accounting.

Key job responsibilities

This role performs a wide variety of responsibilities for the Global Tax Data organization including:

Perform hands on detailed data research and analysis of a large financial data set; investigate, troubleshoot and resolve data quality issues.
Work with customer teams to identify improvements in efficiency and controllership for their current data processes
Teach Tax Compliance and Data teams how to utilize the designed reporting and functionality in their processes.
Build and maintain relationships with our key technology providers, as well as other technical teams across Amazon.
Explain financial/technical concepts and analysis implications clearly to a wide audience, and be able to translate business objectives into actionable analyses.
Define and maintain metrics to quantify the value of data standardization
Get things done - drive implementation of their ideas!

A day in the life

You start the morning checking in with international operations and technology teams, reviewing data quality issues and data simplification roadmaps. By mid-morning, you're deep in source analysis — tracing a tax-reportable attribute back through multiple systems to identify which service originally produces the data and documenting the field-level mapping for the team that will build the integration.

After lunch, you join a working session with an upstream engineering team to resolve a sourcing ambiguity you flagged last week. You document the outcome and update the controllership tracker.

Later in the day, you're translating your findings into business requirements for the technical team that builds our tax data platform. You're not writing code, but you need to understand the data well enough to define what "correct" looks like for a given field.

Your internal stakeholders span Tax Compliance teams who consume the data for filings, technology teams who build the pipelines, and upstream service owners who produce the source data. Your customers are the Tax and Accounting professionals who need to trust every number in a compliance report.

About The Team

We operate in a fast growing Tax Data space, so we're looking for candidates who are eager and able to learn new content quickly, who are willing to go into unfamiliar territory, and who possess ironclad judgment and integrity around confidential information.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
3+ years of writing SQL queries and creating business intelligence reports using Tableau, Power BI experience
Bachelor's degree
Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights

Preferred Qualifications

MBA
Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field, or experience supporting the implementation of controls or contributing to audits over financial reporting environments
Experience with data lineage or data governance frameworks

Description

We are seeking a mid-career Geospatial Analyst to join our Mid-Atlantic Environmental Services Geospatial team. This role is intended for a technically strong, collaborative professional who can work with increasing independence, apply sound judgment to moderately complex GIS assignments, and help translate client and project needs into practical geospatial solutions within Esri ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and related field and web-mapping platforms.

As a member of Stantec’s Environmental Services Geospatial team, comprising more than 160 geospatial professionals, you will contribute to project delivery, client service, and technical problem solving across environmental, infrastructure, and regulatory work. The successful candidate will bring broad technical knowledge, demonstrate initiative in adapting established workflows, support quality and efficiency improvements, and communicate effectively with multidisciplinary project teams.

As a Geospatial Analyst with Stantec, you will provide technical support and applied GIS expertise for assigned projects, including mapping applications, spatial analysis, web mapping, data management, field data workflows, and map production. This full-time position supports our Mid-Atlantic Region Environmental Services group and offers opportunities to mentor junior staff, strengthen repeatable workflows, and contribute to consistent project delivery.

Your Key Responsibilities

Compile, create, maintain, and QA/QC spatial and non-spatial data across Esri ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and related project platforms, applying established data standards and recommending improvements when appropriate.
Work in Windows 11 Enterprise and using MS Office suite of applications (Teams, Outlook, Word, Access, Excel, SharePoint).
Produce custom thematic map products, spatial analyses, data summaries, and visual deliverables that clearly communicate project findings and support multidisciplinary decision-making.
Develop and maintain web maps, dashboards, field data collection tools, and hosted data workflows using ArcGIS Online, Survey123, Field Maps, and related applications.
Support and help coordinate geospatial field data collection efforts, including preparation of mobile maps and forms, field data review, troubleshooting, and integration of field observations into project datasets.
Apply established cartographic standards and Quality Assurance / Quality Control processes while identifying opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, and repeatability across common GIS deliverables.
Manage a wide variety of project-specific and reference geospatial data in accordance with defined data management standards, including appropriate organization, documentation, permissions, and data lifecycle practices.
Recognize when technical issues, data inconsistencies, or workflow risks are developing; initiate appropriate corrective actions and communicate options to project managers or senior technical staff.
Collaborate with GIS staff, environmental practitioners, project managers, and other disciplines across Stantec offices to support efficient delivery and shared technical standards.
Provide day-to-day technical guidance, review, or mentoring to junior GIS staff on assigned tasks, including data preparation, mapping workflows, field applications, and QA/QC expectations.
Report to the Mid-Atlantic Geospatial Team Lead while coordinating closely with project managers and technical leads on schedule, budget, quality, and delivery expectations.

Qualifications

Your Capabilities and Credentials

Demonstrated experience working with the Esri ArcGIS software suite, primarily ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Online, with practical experience using tools such as ArcGIS Experience Builder, ArcGIS Field Maps, and ArcGIS Survey123.
Experience applying GIS to solve project problems, support client and team decision-making, present results, and clearly communicate analytical findings to multidisciplinary audiences.
Strong technical training and professional experience in GIS mapping, geospatial analysis, data management, and geographic principles, including map projections, coordinate systems, and data transformation workflows.
Demonstrated understanding of cartography, data visualization, and graphic communication, with the ability to create clear, accurate, and client-ready map and dashboard products.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative consulting environment while managing multiple assignments, adapting to changing priorities, and maintaining quality standards.
Ability to work under minimal supervision, estimate and communicate task needs, meet project deadlines, and understand how assigned work supports broader project goals, budget, and client expectations.
Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams, clients, field staff, and project managers through clear communication, responsiveness, and sound professional judgment.
Ability to perform work accurately in a detail-oriented environment.
Exceptional visual, written, and verbal communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
Experience converting, standardizing, and integrating data from legacy or external sources into accurate digital GIS formats while documenting assumptions, limitations, and quality considerations.
Valid state driver’s license

Preferred

Knowledge of Arcade, Python, and other GIS Programming languages.
Working knowledge CAD software, such as AutoCAD or MicroStation platforms.
Experience performing environmental fieldwork using a GPS and post-processing data is beneficial but not required.
Experience working with cultural data
Experience working with LiDAR data.

Bachelors’ degree or equivalent in GIS, Geography, Geoscience, Environmental Science, or related field with demonstrated GIS training or coursework.
Minimum of five years of related professional GIS experience; 10 years preferred, with a demonstrated ability to work independently on broad and varied assignments

Position Summary

The Data Analyst – Real Property & Business Intelligence

provides facility analysis, real property database support, data management, analytics, and business intelligence support for the Office of the Surgeon General (OTSG) / U.S. Army Medical Command (MEDCOM).

The position is responsible for managing, analyzing, validating, and maintaining facilities data used to support Medical Readiness, the Army Facility Investment Plan (FIP), operational decision-making, dashboards, reports, meetings, and other government deliverables. The analyst works across multiple data systems and sources to identify relationships, validate information, resolve discrepancies, develop analytical products, and provide reliable data to government stakeholders. The position also supports dashboard development and maintenance, process improvement, knowledge management, technical documentation, and training related to Real Property Systems.

Accommodation Requests

We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, contact careers@bodwegroup.com.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The following inexhaustive list of duties represents a sample of work routinely performed by this role:

Manage, analyze, validate, and prepare facilities data supporting OTSG/MEDCOM operations and Medical Readiness.
Conduct data mining, routine analysis, modeling, and research using information from diverse sources.
Query, interpret, and report data using sound analytical and research methodologies.
Analyze relationships between multiple data systems and blend information using effective data-management techniques.
Perform detailed analysis to identify challenges, determine root causes, and develop recommendations and solutions.
Prepare ad hoc queries, reports, data calls, and analytical productsbased on government requirements.
Prepare and summarize weekly, monthly, and periodic operational results for key stakeholders.
Translate analytical findings into clear reports, specifications, instructions, flowcharts, and other deliverables.

Provide analytical and database support for MEDCOM facilities and Army Real Property programs.
Review, manage, and validate facility information within applicable Real Property Systems.
Analyze facility data supporting the Army Facility Investment Plan (FIP).
Review project documentation and facility data to support investment planning and Medical Readiness requirements.
Identify discrepancies between facility inventory and system data, determine root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
Maintain accurate and reliable facilities information through data entry, database queries, validation, and quality-control processes.
Acquire and maintain access to applicable Army Real Property systems, including:

DAIS
GFEBS
HQIIS
ISR
ePRISMS
LOGICOLE
FROID
ASIP
BUILDER
Vantage
RPLANS

Develop and implement data collection, reporting, and quality-control standards.

Monitor data integrity across multiple systems and identify discrepancies or inconsistencies.
Review data sources and collection mechanisms to identify opportunities for improvement.
Establish processes that promote standardized and reliable data reporting.
Maintain operational processes by following established policies and procedures and recommending changes when necessary.

Business Intelligence & Dashboard Support

Support the creation, maintenance, and updating of business intelligence dashboards supporting Army Medical Readiness.
Provide analytical support for dashboard-based deliverables and Medical Readiness reporting.
Participate in the full analytical lifecycle, from project requirements and data extraction through data manipulation, reporting, dashboard design, and delivery of results.
Pull, manipulate, analyze, and export data to support dashboard and reporting requirements.
Support dashboard creation, updates, data integration, and management for MEDCOM.
Work with multiple data sources to identify relationships and develop integrated analytical solutions.
Help ensure dashboard data is accurate, current, standardized, and aligned with government requirements.

Process Improvement

Plan and lead database and analytical process-improvement initiatives.
Evaluate existing processes, identify inefficiencies, and recommend improvements.
Develop standardized procedures for data collection, analysis, reporting, and knowledge management.
Identify opportunities to improve data reliability, accessibility, efficiency, and usability.
Develop documentation, specifications, instructions, and process flowcharts to support improved operations.

Knowledge Management & Documentation

Ensure knowledge-management documentation is accurate, organized, properly archived, and accessible to authorized users.
Manage appropriate document access permissions and information-sharing requirements.
Ensure accurate and timely distribution of knowledge-management documentation between internal and external customers.
Maintain documentation supporting MEDCOM facilities, analytical processes, projects, and operational activities.
Participate in project meetings in a technical advisory and documentation capacity.
Prepare meeting notes, action items, decisions, follow-up requirements, and other supporting documentation.
Support effective communication and knowledge transfer among government stakeholders, customers, and project team members.

Training & Technical Support

Conduct training related to Army Real Property Systems, data processes, dashboards, and analytical deliverables.
Provide technical and analytical support to Medical Readiness Commands.
Assist stakeholders in understanding data, analytical findings, reporting requirements, and dashboard outputs.
Provide technical guidance regarding data-management practices and system processes.

Stakeholder & Customer Support

Collaborate with MEDCOM, OTSG, project teams, government stakeholders, and other customers to understand analytical requirements.
Participate in project meetings and provide technical and analytical recommendations.
Communicate complex data and analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Support management-defined objectives, project timelines, deliverables, and priorities.
Provide responsive and professional customer service throughout project execution.

Travel

May be required to travel to various locations throughout the United States to support program execution, meetings, training, data collection, or other government requirements.

Required Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum of 2 years of experience performing data analyst-related duties.
Demonstrated experience working with data dashboards and data integration programs.
5+ years of demonstrated experience using Microsoft Excel for data analysis and reporting.
Comprehensive understanding of the MEDCOM mission and operational environment sufficient to support knowledge-management and analytical requirements.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
Demonstrated ability to analyze information, interpret results, identify trends, and recommend resolutions.
Strong analytical, research, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment.
Ability to meet management-established goals, milestones, and deadlines.
Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a Real ID or Passport in order to undergo commercial airfare travel
Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a valid driver's license

Description

Amazon's Global Tax Data team seeks a capable and motivated individual to optimize tax data delivery processes by developing simple standard data models to drive evolution in our data management products. Success in our initiatives will ultimately lower the operation cost to serve Tax Compliance and Controllership.

The right individual should have an ability to work with large datasets. They will also have solid business judgment that enables their development of business logic to transform data and meet the needs of Tax and Accounting.

Key job responsibilities

This role performs a wide variety of responsibilities for the Global Tax Data organization including:

Perform hands on detailed data research and analysis of a large financial data set; investigate, troubleshoot and resolve data quality issues.
Work with customer teams to identify improvements in efficiency and controllership for their current data processes
Teach Tax Compliance and Data teams how to utilize the designed reporting and functionality in their processes.
Build and maintain relationships with our key technology providers, as well as other technical teams across Amazon.
Explain financial/technical concepts and analysis implications clearly to a wide audience, and be able to translate business objectives into actionable analyses.
Define and maintain metrics to quantify the value of data standardization
Get things done - drive implementation of their ideas!

A day in the life

You start the morning checking in with international operations and technology teams, reviewing data quality issues and data simplification roadmaps. By mid-morning, you're deep in source analysis — tracing a tax-reportable attribute back through multiple systems to identify which service originally produces the data and documenting the field-level mapping for the team that will build the integration.

After lunch, you join a working session with an upstream engineering team to resolve a sourcing ambiguity you flagged last week. You document the outcome and update the controllership tracker.

Later in the day, you're translating your findings into business requirements for the technical team that builds our tax data platform. You're not writing code, but you need to understand the data well enough to define what "correct" looks like for a given field.

Your internal stakeholders span Tax Compliance teams who consume the data for filings, technology teams who build the pipelines, and upstream service owners who produce the source data. Your customers are the Tax and Accounting professionals who need to trust every number in a compliance report.

About The Team

We operate in a fast growing Tax Data space, so we're looking for candidates who are eager and able to learn new content quickly, who are willing to go into unfamiliar territory, and who possess ironclad judgment and integrity around confidential information.

5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience

Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights

About The Position

Mason Technologies is seeking a Project Coordinator
to support the successful delivery of our low-voltage technology and electrical integration projects. This position works closely with Project Managers, field technicians, warehouse teams, vendors, and customers to coordinate the day-to-day activities required to keep construction projects moving from award through completion.

The ideal candidate has experience in commercial construction, electrical contracting, low-voltage systems, or a related field and is comfortable coordinating between office operations and field installation teams. This role is focused on supporting the successful delivery of projects through effective scheduling, material coordination, documentation, project tracking, and communication. Our projects involve the installation and integration of systems such as structured cabling, audiovisual systems, security, access control, fiber optics, and other low-voltage technology infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Coordinate low-voltage construction projects from project award through completion and closeout.
Coordinate with Project Managers, field technicians, general contractors, vendors, warehouse, and customers to keep projects on schedule.
Assist with project scheduling, technician assignments, site access, material procurement, and deliveries.
Track project progress, milestones, materials, and outstanding items.
Review technician reports, project documentation, and system updates for accuracy.
Communicate project updates and resolve scheduling, material, and field-related issues.
Assist with change orders, project documentation, billing, and final project closeout.
Maintain accurate project records and ensure compliance with company procedures.

Qualifications

2+ years of experience in commercial construction, electrical, low-voltage, telecommunications, AV, security, or a related industry preferred.
Experience in project coordination, construction administration, or a similar role.
Understanding of construction workflows, including scheduling, material procurement, field installation, and project closeout.
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
Experience with CRM, ERP, or construction management software; ConnectWise is a plus.
Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Experience with structured cabling, fiber, audiovisual, security, or access control is a plus.

$55,000.00-$60,000.00/year

Full-Time, In-Person
